title: Long Time Barkers
text: We have been BarkBox Subscribers for over a year, and we are now getting 2 boxes a month after adding to our family. We have had our boxes tailored to our needs for our pets (diet sensitivity and toy preference) and they have always had amazing customer service for us. We have spoken with them several times when a box has come with something we couldn't use and they always make it right without charging the customer. They have great integrity and great toys. Particularly Gordon the Giant Sloth is one of my boy's absolute favorites. He sleeps with it nearby 20 hours a day.
label: positive
